accepted: Place recoil/hit after aiming and restrict additive bones to the spine branch.
Drive one-shot times from actual world time and cancel on invalid gameplay state.
not_adopted: Qwen suggested nonexistent proxy/enum APIs and invalid authority checks; local Engine APIs and existing pawn lifecycle are used.
No arbitrary 0.1-second stale threshold: existing motion discontinuity boundary and real clip durations are used.
Asset additive type is required: prior exact readback identifies mesh-space fire and local-space hit.
implementation: Existing native graph gains a masked additive node, confirmed-shot hooks in player/rival, and applied-hit hook in base pawn. Rapid hits do not restart an active clip; no queue. Defeat still immediately hides the live mesh and cancels actions.
